items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive who is conducting the interview with Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris. No personal or professional relationship between the interviewees and Monk Rowe is described in the text.

ctx.x: Phoebe and Jackie were interviewed in Rome, New York on August 21, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we’re in Rome, New York filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. And I’m really pleased to have two great friends and patrons of jazz with me, Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris. Welcome.
Thank you very much. We’re delighted to be here.
